svg.title: Vidhursh Kumar V
svg.desc: Full-length photo of Vidhursh smiling beside a plant and an elephant stone carving, with hand-drawn doodles: a speech bubble saying vanakkam, I am Vidhursh; a pixel-art player card reading Player 01, class AI and data, base Chennai, mode build; and stickers for Python, LLMs, SQL, RAG and dbt.
